setup.reference: Liang et al. 2018, ICPR (SCUT-FBP5500 best backbone)
setup.paper_quote: ResNeXt-50 obtains the best performance, PC 0.8997 by 5-fold cross validation and 0.8777 by 60% training / 40% testing.
setup.deviation_from_paper: Same protocol difference as cnn-resnet18. The paper's 0.8997 is on SCUT-FBP5500 and must not be compared with any number produced here. Early stopping on the validation split (patience 5) replaces the paper's fixed schedule: benchmark-v1 is a single fixed split, so a fixed epoch count would report whatever the last epoch produced rather than the method's best honest result.
